documents.title: Greene County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 48 pages. Amounts are the "2026 Budget" (detail pages) / "2026 Appropriations" (p. 48 summary) / ordinance amounts by department column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
